description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the CandidateDao class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It tests CRUD operations, filtering, and history recording functionalities related to candidate management in the recruitment process.

classes.name: CandidateDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the CandidateDao class, covering CRUD operations, filtering, and history logging.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates a CandidateDao instance, and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveCandidate
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a new Candidate entity.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests saving a CandidateVacancy entity linked to a candidate and vacancy.

methods.name: testGetCandidateById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a candidate by ID, including a null case for non-existent ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of candidate vacancy details by candidate ID, including non-existent case.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidates
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple candidates by their IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests deletion of a candidate vacancy record.

methods.name: testGetCandidateList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of candidates with default filters.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByCandidateId
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by specific candidate ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by vacancy ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByJobTitleId
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by job title ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by hiring manager ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByStatus
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by recruitment status.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByKeywords
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates based on keywords related to their profile.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByMethodOfApplication
methods.description: Tests filtering candidates by method of application.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Tests recording of candidate history actions, such as rejection.
